title: About Us | Winkelmann Group
content: Tel: +49 2382 856-0 | info@winkelmann-group.com. The Winkelmann Group, headquartered in Ahlen, Germany, is an internationally positioned group of companies for industrial solutions of high-performance and energy-efficient components and systems. In the 2024 financial year, we generated sales of about € 660 million. As a leader for industrial solutions of energy-efficient and high-performance systems and components - our core competence - we develop innovative products for renowned customers in the automotive, utility, and aerospace industries. We are particularly well known for our famous companies and business areas such as Winkelmann Automotive, reflexGroup, Winkelmann Flowforming, Winkelmann Construction Components and Winkelmann Erneuerbare Energien. Our Steel Services division complements our range of products and is a dependable service provider to steel processors. And our more than 4,000 employees worldwide are the reason for this. With more than a hundred years of success, our family business, the Winkelmann Group has developed into a leading group of companies worldwide, focusing on our core competence of metal forming. Through our Automotive, reflexGroup, Flowforming and Construction Components business units, we manufacture high-performance systems and components by means of high-tech production processes involving forming, machining and assembly.
